# Native osquery result fixtures

The committed JSONL logs were emitted by the real **osquery 5.24.1** Linux daemon,
using an isolated filesystem logger and a synthetic pack. `adhoc.json` was emitted
by the matching osqueryi shell. No production endpoint, management API or real
hunting data was used, and no source logs were hand-converted into other formats.

- `event.jsonl` / `snapshot-event.jsonl`: added and removed event-format rows.
- `batch.jsonl`: native batched differentials.
- `event-snapshots.jsonl` / `batch-snapshots.jsonl`: array snapshots, including
  explicitly empty snapshots.
- `snapshot-event-snapshots.jsonl`: flattened snapshot events. Empty executions
  do not emit events in this native mode.
- `adhoc.json`: standalone shell JSON rows, whose column values are strings.
- `sources.json`: unmodified sources map returned by the existing hunting-pack
  builder, including the original indicator reference.
- `manifest.json`: synthetic source event, stable query identity, pack name and
  producer version. Paths point only into the disposable fixture workspace.

The differential query is generated by MISP's existing osquery pack builder for
an exact synthetic file path. Removing that fixture file yields the native
`removed` row. Removed-row logging is enabled only for this test pack, preserving
the exporter's default behavior. Two constant SQL snapshot queries exercise JSON
numeric values and zero-row snapshots. Host identity is explicitly `fixture-host`,
and the schedule epoch is fixed at 314159265. Native execution dates/counters are
left unchanged, so regenerating fixtures can change those values.

Reproduction requires osquery 5.24.1 and the repository's existing Python imports:

```sh
OSQUERYD=/path/to/osqueryd PYTHONPATH=. python tests/fixtures/osquery/reproduce.py
```

The script writes daemon configuration/state/logs and a synthetic indicator file
under `/workspace/work/osquery-native` (override `OSQUERY_FIXTURE_WORK`), runs three
short-lived daemon configurations, and terminates its own processes. Watchdog,
events and extensions are disabled; only a local filesystem logger is configured.
The fixture generator is optional: ordinary importer tests use committed logs and
do not require an osquery binary.

Reviewed upstream contracts:

- [5.24.1 release](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/releases/tag/5.24.1)
- [logging formats](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/blob/1b34ff7fa3febd46d026db51a5225defa27a4005/docs/wiki/deployment/logging.md)
- [serialization](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/blob/1b34ff7fa3febd46d026db51a5225defa27a4005/osquery/core/query.cpp)
- [logger selection](https://github.com/osquery/osquery/blob/1b34ff7fa3febd46d026db51a5225defa27a4005/osquery/logger/logger.cpp)
